setup.instruction: Wait for demo controls to become interactive.

intro_walkthrough.instruction: Establish the editor with the game view and HUD visible.

outro_walkthrough.instruction: Hold on the completed editor view.

source.before: Resizing the browser could leave the game view at its boot size and overlay handles out of alignment.
source.after: The live game view grows or shrinks with the browser, every overlay handle stays on its element, and the engine reports both virtual console size and true backing-store pixels.
source.value: The editing-size readout and the HUD stay aligned with the picture on screen.

treatments.text: Resizing the browser now keeps your game view and HUD controls aligned.

walkthrough.instruction: Show the game view at the smaller browser size.
Hold briefly on the smaller game view.
Resize the browser and let the game view follow.
Wait for the resized editing-size readout.
Hold on the aligned resized view.

source.before: The editor had no Pause or Resume control, so lining up the HUD meant waiting for a useful demo frame.
source.after: Pause and Resume sit beside the demo selector and follow the engine's real state, including console changes and an honest disabled reason on unsupported backends.
source.value: You can stop on a quiet frame and adjust the HUD without losing the moment you wanted.

treatments.text: Pause now holds frames steady, so you can edit the HUD without losing your moment.

walkthrough.instruction: Pause the running demo from the editor control.
Wait for engine readback to confirm the pause.
Hold on the steady demo frame.
Resume demo playback from the same control.
Wait for engine readback to confirm playback.
